cards.front: The standard approach of Soft Tissue Balancing is to achieve equal medial and lateral tension at 0 ° and 90 °.
cards.extra: * These two reference points (0° & 90°) are used because its technically easiest for surgeons during the procedure, but the goal is to stabilize the knee throughout the full range of motion (every degree from 0° - 130°). Its clearly impractical to attempt to balance the knee every 5°, yet the question remains whether these 2 check points are sufficient to ensure a balanced knee.
